sessions.phase_label: Collateral requirements and initial design scoping

requirements.title: CAS Jets Business Portfolio
requirements.definition: Produce a customized aircraft-focused CAS Jets business portfolio with an exclusive, premium, visually impactful presentation and restrained text.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the specifically named CAS Jets portfolio. Aircraft tailoring, premium appearance, text density, imagery, and visual impact are attributes of this artifact rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Second Business Portfolio
requirements.definition: Produce the additional business portfolio required alongside the separately identifiable CAS Jets portfolio.
requirements.boundary_note: The client repeatedly requests two portfolios, and later discussion targets CAS Jets independently; the second portfolio is therefore retained as a separate deliverable even though its business identity and detailed specifications are not observable.

requirements.title: Aircraft Business Brochures
requirements.definition: Produce a set of three to four brochures for the client's aircraft-related business.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested brochure count is an attribute of one batch deliverable. Individual brochures are not split because the supplied evidence does not identify distinct subjects or independent lifecycles for them.

requirements.title: Business Pitch Content
requirements.definition: Create content, including suitable imagery, for the client's business pitches.
requirements.boundary_note: Pitch content is retained separately from portfolios and brochures because the client lists it as a distinct content deliverable, although no later detailed specifications are visible.

requirements.title: Social Media Content
requirements.definition: Create a small set of social-media content items for the client's business.
requirements.boundary_note: Social-media content is an independently requested channel deliverable. Platform selection and exact item count remain unspecified attributes rather than separate Requirements.
